title: What the Whale Shark carries

is_this_you.pressure: When the water turns rough, you slow down and go deeper. People up top think you left. You were only below the weather.
is_this_you.love: You come back to the same person the way a season comes back. Sometimes late. Never by accident.
is_this_you.cost: Everyone near you eats well. Some years you notice you fed the whole reef and skipped your own meal.

opener.text: In the old Chinese story, carp swim against the current to a waterfall called the Dragon Gate, and the one that leaps it becomes a dragon [longmen]. People still say 鯉魚跳龍門 (lǐyú tiào lóngmén) for a sudden rise that long effort paid for [longmen]. Pisces is the sign of two fish [wiki-pisces]. The Dragon rules the seas and the rain [cn-dragon]. You were born at the foot of that waterfall, half fish and half dragon, and you have never been in a hurry to jump.

howto: Three parts. Take them at your own depth.

tabs.label: Your size
tabs.intro: Big and slow, and easy about both.

rows.text: Pisces is mutable Water, pictured as two fish swimming opposite ways and read as a double nature with a pull toward drift [wiki-pisces]. The Dragon is yang Earth, courageous and tenacious, willing to take a risk [branches] [chl-dragon]. In the Five Phases, Earth contains Water the way banks hold a river [wuxing]. Your Dragon gives your feelings a course. People sense you before you speak, and something in them settles.

Coastal peoples who never met each other looked at its spots and saw a night sky. In Madagascar it is marokintana, many stars, and in East Java it is geger lintang, star-backed [wiki-ws]. You carry a lot of light and rarely show it off.

tabs.label: What you take in
tabs.intro: A whole sea passes through. You keep what feeds you.

rows.text: A 6 meter whale shark feeding at the surface was estimated to strain about 600 cubic meters of water an hour [motta2010] [sharksorg]. Your version is people. A season of other people's moods moves through you, and you hold on to the small good things in it.

Whale sharks gather at Ningaloo from March to August, after the coral spawns just over a week past the full moon [wa-spawning]. Some have come back to that reef for 19 years [ningaloo-fidelity]. You keep appointments like that. Nobody wrote them down, and you still arrive in season.
Patient work suits you: counselling, long research, or a calm organization you lead without raising your voice.

tabs.label: Who swims near you
tabs.intro: Three who swim with you. One who stirs the water.
tabs.love_lead: In love you return, steadily and a little late. You need someone who reads a slow reply as care. Venus is exalted in Pisces [wiki-pisces], so you give freely and forgive fast. Three old pairings keep close.

easy.why: The Superb Bird of Paradise (Taurus, Rooster year) is your secret friend, the Rooster being the Dragon's six-harmony partner [cny-compat].
The Spotted Cuscus (Cancer, Monkey year) shares your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Cancer is a Water sign like Pisces [cny-compat] [wiki-dragon].
The Vampire Squid (Pisces, Rat year) completes the trine through the Rat and swims under your own sign [cny-compat] [chl-dragon].

hard.why: The hard one is the African Grey Parrot (Gemini, Dog year): the Dog clashes with the Dragon, and quick Gemini squares slow Pisces [cny-compat] [chl-dragon].

story.text: Japanese fishermen called it the Ebisu-shark, after the god of fishermen and luck, because it brought masses of fish and was believed to protect them [ebisu] [whale-worship]. On Kenya's Diani coast it is papa shillingi, the shark covered in shillings, and legend says God had angels drop the coins there to honor its beauty [natgeo-kenya].

closing: Swim on, slow and wide. Whoever keeps close to you eats well.
